average.description: Averaging period in seconds. Default is 60.

interface.description: Network interface to read data from.

debug.description: Debug level. 0 - no debugging; 1 - summary; 2 - subnet statistics; 3 - all packets. Default is 0.

fork.description: Run in background. Default is no.

outfile.description: Filename to output detailed subnet report. Default is ipband.txt in current directory.

htmlfile.description: HTML report output file. Default is ipband.html in current directory.

htmltitle.description: HTML title of the report output file.

bandwidth.description: Bandwidth threshold in kBytes per second. Default is 7.0 kBps.

lenadj.description: Packet length adjustment in bytes. Default is 0.

report.description: Reporting period - number of seconds bandwidth threshold may be exceeded before report. Default is 300 seconds.

top.description: Limit subnet report to a given number of per-host connections. Default is 0 (no limit).

accumulate.description: Include threshold exceeded accumulated time and percentage in report. Default is no.

mailto.description: Email address(es) to send detailed subnet report to.

mailfoot.description: File to be appended to the end of e-mail reports.

mtastring.description: MTA command string for mailing reports.

maskbits.description: Number of network mask bits (1-32). Default is 24.

subnets.description: List of subnet configurations. Each item must have 'ip' (subnet-ip) and 'bandwidth' (kBps). Note: In the config file, these are formatted as 'subnet <ip> <bandwidth>' lines, not as a structured block like in the previous schema. The template generates these lines directly from the list items.
